label: VERIFIED
extraction: Plan-Orchestrate: bridges plan document to /orchestrate custom by emitting ready-to-paste invocations per step. Generative only - never executes /orchestrate. Detects ECC install form (plugin vs legacy) to determine command prefix (/ecc:orchestrate vs /orchestrate) and agent name format (ecc:name vs name). Available agent catalogue: planner, architect, tdd-guide, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, refactor-cleaner, doc-updater, docs-lookup, e2e-runner, database-reviewer, harness-optimizer, loop-operator, chief-of-staff, language-specific reviewers and build resolvers. Phase 0: detect ECC mode + language. Phase 1: decompose steps from explicit numbering, tables, or H2 headings. Phase 2: tag by intent (design, plan, impl, test, refactor, migration, db, security, build, docs, lookup, review, loop) and pick chain with composition rules. Phase 3: compress task description (self-contained, starts with [Plan: path#step-id], includes 1-3 acceptance criteria, optional scope guard). Phase 4: output markdown with overview table and per-step bash blocks. Phase 5: self-check validation. Handles edge cases: no clear steps, large plans (>1500 lines = overview-only mode), steps too broad, plan declares agents, polyglot projects.
